# Owned artifact upload

Preserves workflow evidence for seven days. The calling job needs Python 3.11 or
newer and `id-token: write` permission.

The client at `ops/artifacts/client.py` is an unchanged copy from
`nextidemedia/ci-infra` commit
`2a2a72972f2bbc5035ab19a8a8211b1e277fd273`, path `ops/artifacts/client.py`.
Its SHA-256 is
`8b742bde2f3ba3920fd437153aabb99d863b4d8fe84fd31dbc07ddd88a988d25`.

Update the client from a qualified shared release and record its commit and hash
here. Workflows pin this public action to its merged commit, independently of the
application revision being checked.
